attchmntText: Bedmutha Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication in which Financial Results of quarter ended Sept 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Bedmutha Industries Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors considered, approved, and took these results on record during a meeting held on November 06, 2026. The advertisements were published on 07th November, 2026, in The Free Press Journal in English and Navshakti in Marathi. The information has also been uploaded to the company website at www.bedmutha.com. This submission is made pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Bedmutha Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
